decisions.rationale: Reproduced by the reconciler on the final bytes at 89064f80 (r2 snapshot; lab.json sha256 e33fcf1a...) with the private reference overlay. Changing only createService's URL to '/api/service' (a task-4 bug) makes test 3 fail with 'Unable to find role="heading" and name "Image Resizer"', alongside tests 4, 5 and 7. Test 3's release step awaits the overview card, which only a working task 4 produces, and the README does not disclose this. The claim is true. Fix, in tests/t3-client-validation.test.jsx only: import waitFor from @testing-library/react. Replace the release block's 'await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 3, name: "Image Resizer" })' with 'await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: /Saving/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument())', still inside if (api.releaseHeld) { api.releaseHeld(); ... }. This settles the held request whether the form re-enabled or navigated away, without asserting task-4 behaviour. No README change is needed, because the coupling disappears. Combined fix (both changes) verified in a scratch copy of the final bytes. The reference passes 8/8 with no act/Unhandled warnings. The shipped starter fails all 8 under the same names, and its test 3 now fails with 'handleSubmit must call event.preventDefault(): expected 0 to be greater than 0'. The createService wrong-URL variant fails only tests 4, 5 and 7; test 3 passes. The preventDefault+stopPropagation variant passes 8/8. The no-preventDefault variant fails only test 3, with the labelled message. Mutants keep their r1 outcomes: f1 passes; f2 fails tests 3 and 8; f3 and f4 fail test 5; f5 fails tests 6 and 7. Test names, failingTests and expected/on-completion.txt are unchanged. The test edit invalidates the solved-run and lock bindings, which must be re-recorded.

Reproduced by the reconciler on the final bytes at 89064f80 (r2 snapshot; lab.json sha256 e33fcf1a...) with the private reference overlay. Adding only event.stopPropagation() after event.preventDefault() in the reference handler fails test 3 with 'expected [] to deeply equal [ true ]' (7/8 pass). A correct handler is rejected because the window bubble listener never sees the event. The claim is true. Fix, in tests/t3-client-validation.test.jsx only: replace the window bubble listener with const preventDefault = vi.spyOn(Event.prototype, 'preventDefault') around the first Save click. Collect preventDefault.mock.contexts filtered to event.type === 'submit', call mockRestore(), and assert expect(cancelledSubmits.length, 'handleSubmit must call event.preventDefault()').toBeGreaterThan(0). Unlike the window listener, the prototype spy detects cancellation regardless of propagation. Combined fix (both changes) verified in a scratch copy of the final bytes. The reference passes 8/8 with no act/Unhandled warnings.
